## Description
Please summarize the proposed changes, the architectural rationale, and link any related issues.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Refactoring / Architectural cleanup
- [ ] Documentation update

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and architecture of this project.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings in `a3/frontend`.
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes with 0 type errors in `a3/frontend`.
- [ ] `npm run build` generates a production build successfully.
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes all tests in `a3/backend`.
- [ ] `alembic check` reports no unhandled schema drift.
